messages:
Maya: main CI turned red after merge, saw it ~2m ago. Failing job: integr/canary-allocator (step: allocate-gpus).
Maya: PR: #4123 merged by @Jordan, commit 8f9a3b2. Job link: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/21345
Maya: logs show container killed with exit code 137, suspect OOM on allocator step.
sre-bot: [auto] Job 21345 failed on runner ephem-07. Step 'allocate-gpus' exited 137. Last log snippet: `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory`
Kevin: pinging in case this is infra vs change in PR. I'll grab logs and try a local repro.
Jordan: thanks — that PR touched kv-shard allocation and the allocator config. I can revert if needed but want to confirm root cause first.
Annie: can we try a rerun on that job first? Often a transient node OOM.
Kevin: agree. Rerunning job 21345 now via `cictl rerun --job 21345 --preserve-cache`
Kevin: rerun queued on a different runner (ephem-12). Will update in ~5m.
Maya: if rerun fails, can we bisect between commits 8f9a3b2..main~10? That range includes the PR.
Kevin: if rerun fails, I'll bisect. Steps: `git fetch origin main && git bisect start main origin/main~10` then mark good/bad with the unit/integration smoke.
Kevin: rerun finished — still failed on ephem-12, same OOM in allocate-gpus. Logs look similar.
Annie: Ok not transient. Jordan, can you flag the PR for revert or do you want engineering to bisect?
Jordan: I can revert quickly, but prefer bisect to avoid churning if it's another commit. If Kevin can bisect and confirm culprit within 30m, hold off on revert.
Kevin: starting bisect now. Will push updates here. Running smoke job in loop locally to speed checks.
Maya: adding an incident note in #incidents with link and brief impact (main CI blocked for merges).
Kevin: quick update — bisect narrowed it to commit 3c7d4f9 (allocator:change default eager_pool_size). Reproduced locally with that commit.
Jordan: thanks — that matches code review concerns about eager allocation.
Annie: given repro, I'd revert since change increases GPU resident memory. Jordan: can you open revert PR?
Jordan: opened revert PR #4130 reverting 3c7d4f9. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4130
Maya: once revert merges, please queue a CI run and notify here.
Kevin: confirm: revert queued, smoke integration passed on ephem-15. main CI green again.
Maya: closing loop — thanks everyone. We should add a guard in CI to run a small OOM-sensitive integration job before merging allocator changes.
Jordan: agree, filing follow-up ticket. :thumbsup:
